copy-button.name: Copy Button
copy-button.purpose: Copy a specific value or source snippet to the clipboard with clear accessible name, success/error feedback, disabled state, and no ambiguity about what will be copied.

anatomy.rule: Native button semantics with Flow button or icon-button behavior.
Visible label or icon-only mode must have a clear accessible name.
Copied and error feedback is exposed through text and live announcement.

variants.description: Visible text button for explicit copy actions.
Compact icon-only copy action with required accessible name.
Small action paired with token, command, or metadata value.

copy-button.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > copied > pressed > focus > hover > default

Voice.decision: Use labels that name the copied value or source.
Voice.behavior: Users understand the copy target before activation.
Voice.test: Verify accessible name includes copy target when needed.
Voice.rejectIf: The label is only 'Copy' when multiple copy targets are present.

Frame.decision: Use Flow button/icon-button sizing and density.
Frame.behavior: Copy actions fit inline or header contexts without resizing layout.
Frame.test: Verify layout stability after copied feedback.

Depth.decision: Use inherited Button/Icon Button depth rather than a new floating treatment.
Depth.behavior: Copy action sits inside its owning row or code header.
Depth.test: Verify no standalone elevated copy surface.
Depth.rejectIf: Copy Button creates a new card or overlay.

Momentum.decision: Use tokenized Button/Icon Button interaction and feedback timing.
Momentum.behavior: Copied/error feedback feels responsive and respects reduced motion.
Momentum.example: Copied state resolves after feedback duration.
Momentum.test: Verify feedback timing and reduced motion.
Momentum.rejectIf: Clipboard feedback uses raw timing or distracting motion.

State.decision: Resolve disabled, loading, error, copied, pressed, focus, and hover states.
State.behavior: Clipboard success and failure are explicit and recoverable.
State.example: Copy fails because clipboard API is unavailable.
State.test: Verify copied/error state timing and announcement.

Tone.decision: Use concise target labels and recovery copy for clipboard errors.
Tone.behavior: Users know what was copied and what to do if copying fails.
Tone.example: Copy failed, review permissions and retry.
Tone.test: Verify error feedback includes recovery language.
Tone.rejectIf: The control only says Copy when multiple targets exist.

Energy.decision: Keep copy feedback immediate, bounded, and calm so clipboard confirmation does not compete with the surrounding task.
Energy.behavior: Copied and error states confirm the action without adding a new visual surface or persistent interruption.
Energy.example: Copied state resolves after the feedback duration.
Energy.test: Verify feedback timing is bounded and does not shift layout.
Energy.rejectIf: Copy feedback becomes a blocking toast, modal, or animated distraction.

Growth.decision: Keep Copy Button as one clipboard action and escalate bulk copy or workflow logic to patterns.
Growth.behavior: The component does not own multi-item selection or export flows.
Growth.test: Verify one explicit value per control.
Growth.rejectIf: Copy Button becomes a bulk export pattern.

Symbol.decision: Use approved symbol names for icon variant.
Symbol.behavior: The copy icon supports but never replaces the accessible name.
Symbol.rejectIf: Custom glyph or unlabeled icon-only copy is used.

Iconography.decision: Use Icon Button icon sizing for compact copy actions.
Iconography.behavior: Icon copy action aligns with surrounding controls.
Iconography.rejectIf: Icon sizing is local or mismatched.

Accessibility.decision: Preserve native button semantics, focus, accessible name, live feedback, and disabled behavior.
Accessibility.behavior: Keyboard and assistive technology users can copy and receive feedback.
Accessibility.test: Verify name, role, focus, disabled, and live feedback.
Accessibility.rejectIf: Copy is implemented as a div/span or visual icon only.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: compact metadata or code header action

props.name: ariaLabel
props.notes: Required for icon or ambiguous contexts.

props.name: feedbackDuration
props.notes: Duration for copied feedback, using Duration/Motion contracts.

props.name: disabled
props.notes: Blocks copy and exposes disabled state.

do: Name the copied target when there are multiple copy actions.
Use icon variant only with an accessible name.
dont: Do not silently fail when clipboard access is unavailable.
Do not use generic labels for multiple copy targets.
Do not implement copy as a local span or div.
info: Copy Button composes Button or Icon Button semantics; it exists because clipboard state and feedback need a reusable contract.

tests: Accessible name for icon and ambiguous contexts.
No local copy controls in migrated docs pages.
agentInstructions: Use Copy Button for clipboard actions in documentation templates and code blocks.
Do not create local copy controls in FlowDocs.
Reject ambiguous copy labels when multiple values can be copied.
rejectIf: The action copies an unclear or changing value.
The control has no accessible name.
The copy action is implemented with local HTML instead of Button or Icon Button semantics.
State feedback changes layout size unpredictably.
